It is wired into the Independence aggregator as that directory's fourteenth result, pinned by eleven re-measured C14 axiom baseline pairs, rowed twice in docs/theorem-index.md in conditional form, recorded in the directory README, and reflected in the regenerated inventory and typst count blocks. Every landed surface names hinexpr as the unformalized paper step, so no surface claims the unconditional Base/Dense verdict is machine-checked.
